### What are you trying to do?

Tell us what task you want to complete or what you want to build.

### Which skill or file are you looking at?

Name the skill, guide, or folder (for example, `skills/intent-mirror/`).

### What is your question?

Ask your question in your own words. There are no silly questions.

### What AI tool are you using?

For example: Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, or another tool.
